ruling_source: Elder general#12851 (ruling) + #12855 (Type-C derivation, ratified) + Whisper Type-A closure
principle: abstention admissibility is decided by what the COMPARATOR can IDENTIFY, not by the budget it is given - identification is what converts a budget into power
derivation: I(G,A;X) <= I(M;X) <= I_acc by data processing (abstain and guess are both functions of the observation); answering fraction f at accuracy a costs f(1-H(a)) bits by Fano; therefore H(a) >= 1 - I_acc/f

TypeB_contextuality.mechanism: best classical assignment fails EXACTLY 1 of 9 contexts and THE CONTEXT IS THE INPUT - identifiable at zero information cost
TypeB_contextuality.verdict: ABSTENTION VOIDS THE CLAIM - advantage exactly zero. A contextuality floor MEANS concentrated identifiable failure, so contextuality advantage and abstention allowance are mutually exclusive BY CONSTRUCTION

TypeA_two_copy.verdict: NOT ALLOWED - comparator has real information to condition on
TypeA_two_copy.HONEST_LABEL: the bound is LOOSE: at zero budget it returns 0.8306 against the true separable optimum 0.5586, so it FAILS Elder own self-consistency test. Reason: chi bounds ANY measurement including joint quantum ones, while the comparator is restricted to SEPARABLE - separability binds long before information does. A tight bound needs the accessible information of the best SEPARABLE measurement, which nobody has computed. The qualitative verdict is safe anyway because 904x is not a factor looseness closes.

TypeC_cloak.consequence: Type C keeps the post-selected 0.9714 vs floor 0.5115, gap 0.4599

why_it_is_a_design_rule: the discriminator is an information quantity computable BEFORE any flight, not a post-hoc argument
